notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! My game will be released on September 25, 2024!

This is a bullet-screen shooting STG game where all bullets can be mutually destructive, and anyone can play happily! I hope you enjoy it!

Sale time is:

12 o 'clock Beijing time! This is my first time to publish a game on Steam, so I hope you can take care of me!

notes.notes:
Q: Need an item description interface, when I play the game, I don't know which item has what effect;
A: OK, I'll think about how to include an easy-to-read description of the item.

Diary of the Week:
1. Hello, everyone. This time, we try to record the log once a day.
2. Recently, I am doing content filling work, and I want to make the content flow of the whole game as rich as possible.
3. Recently developed a new time trigger event, which can trigger events with higher performance when the target is close to another target; Wondering if it could be used in some interesting design;
4. I recently learned Vampire Survivors and wanted to make an off-site store. I thought that this off-site store would enhance the protagonist to a certain extent, which would be very interesting; At the same time, this may also reduce the difficulty of SHMUP/STG games to a certain extent, so that more players can play STG games happily.
5. It seems that the development of off-site stores can be successfully completed, and now I have a headache about how to design off-site stores; If you want to make the overall game much lower, I think you should add more enhancements to off-store stores; At present, I am still thinking about it, and I will see what kind of degree I can achieve by then.
6. Today, I posted in different forums to ask everyone what they think about this STG game, and got different levels of feedback; Now it's time to think about how this feedback can be applied to the game;
7. Today, I optimized the physics engine I wrote in the whole game. Maybe because of today's optimization, I can add a new bullet type to the game.
8. So, this week's journal is the previous ones, so we will see you next week ~

notes.title: 2024-0714: Development Log !
2024-0706: Demo_0.16 version has been updated!
notes.notes:
● Engine:
○ The physical response of 30 milliseconds is used, which is better than the original 60 milliseconds.

● Deep forest:
○ The "Yellow flute" is officially introduced, and when the yellow flute is used after the fifth wave, it will enter the "yellow flute process."
[olist]
[*] In the Yellow Flute flow, the BOSS will be harder, and there will be a BOSS guard.
[*] Moreover, in the wave number of 4, 9, 14, 19, etc., there will be a new set of elite enemies.
[/olist]

● Difficulty related:
○ Using a more compact DAU flow process, the appearance of enemies before the BOSS will be more compact. In contrast, the player will be rewarded with more items for killing enemies.

● System:
○ Added the option to support 5K resolution;
○ Added the option to support full-screen mode.

● Some new bullet types:
○W round, a type of bullets fired by wingmen, which automatically attack enemies and withstand damage.
○H2 bomb is an advanced version of the H bomb.
○R2 is an advanced version of R.

● Elite Monster:
○ Remove the setting that will drop the key;
○ Changed to drop Level 2 emeralds;

● Operation:
○ Remove the V key deceleration setting;
○ Remove the Z key acceleration setting, and change the Z key to slow down;
○ Character base movement speed increased.

● Background:
○ A new background processing system is introduced.
○ Optimized the original background display practice, so that under the new processing system, the background processing performance may be more than 50% rendering improvement.
